## Complete Report: Live Dashboard Routes, UI Components, and Reactive State

### 1. Route Structure under `src/routes/(live)/`

There are **6 files** in this route group:

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(live)\+layout.svelte`** -- The shared layout for all live pages. It wraps content inside `TutorsShell` (which provides MainNavigator + Footer). On mount it fetches catalogue stats. It clears `currentCourse.value` to `null` since these pages are not course-specific. Uses `catalogueService` for stats.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(live)\catalogue\+page.ts`** -- Load function fetches the catalogue from Supabase, filters to courses with 20+ visits, sorts descending by visit count, and returns `courseRecords`.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(live)\catalogue\+page.svelte`** -- Renders a header with "Totals: modules-{totalModules}:students-{totalStudents}" and renders the `<Catalogue>` component with the records.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(live)\live\+page.svelte`** -- The global live dashboard. This is the key entry point:
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { liveService } from "$lib/services/community";
  import Courses from "$lib/ui/time/Courses.svelte";
  import CoursesGroup from "$lib/ui/time/CoursesGroup.svelte";
  import Students from "$lib/ui/time/Students.svelte";
  import { Tabs } from "@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte";

  let group = $state("courses");
  liveService.startGlobalPresenceService();
</script>
```
It renders three Skeleton tabs: "Courses ({count})", "Students ({count})", and "Groups". Calling `liveService.startGlobalPresenceService()` at the top level hooks into the PartyKit WebSocket. The tab counts are reactive via `liveService.coursesOnline.value.length` and `liveService.studentsOnline.value.length`.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(live)\live\[courseid]\+page.ts`** -- Reads the course via `courseService.readCourse`, sets `currentCourse.value`, returns `{ courseid, course }`.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(live)\live\[courseid]\+page.svelte`** -- The per-course live view. This is the most complex live page. It:
- Uses `presenceService` for real-time online students
- Fetches historical activity from `getTutorsConnectLatestLosByCourseId` (Supabase)
- Creates time-bucketed derived values using `$derived.by()`:
  - `losThisDay` -- students active today
  - `losThisWeek` -- this week (excluding today)
  - `losThisMonth` -- this month (excluding this week)
  - `losThisYear` -- this year (excluding this month)
  - `studentsOnlineVisible` -- filters out "Anon" users from presence
- Shows a `CourseGroupHeader` linking to both `/course/{id}` and `/live/{id}`
- Renders "Online Now" section with `ConnectLatestLosCards`
- Renders "Latest Activity" section with Day/Week/Month/Year tabs, each using `ConnectLatestLosCards`

### 2. Key UI Components for Live/Presence/Online

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\navigators\buttons\OnlineButton.svelte`**
Opens a right-side Sidebar showing online students. Reads `presenceService.studentsOnline.value`, filters out "Anon" users, renders each as a `StudentCard` in compacted/landscape layout. The badge shows the count of online students.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\navigators\tutors-connect\ConnectedProfile.svelte`**
The logged-in user's profile menu in the navbar. Shows:
- Avatar with presence indicator (green filled circle if sharing, red outline if not)
- Online student count badge (when sharing is on)
- Menu with: Share Presence toggle, Tutors Time link, Educator Time link (external), Tutors Live link, Online sidebar button, Dashboard link, GitHub profile link, Disconnect button
- The Tutors Live link goes to `/live/{currentCourse.value?.courseId}`

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\navigators\tutors-connect\AnonProfile.svelte`**
The anonymous user's profile menu. Shows a generic avatar with a "Connect" link to `/auth{redirect}` and a Home link.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\StudentCard.svelte`**
The core card component for rendering a student's activity. Props: `lo: LoEvent`, `cardLayout?: CardConfig`, `showCourseTitle?: boolean`. Uses `$derived` extensively for:
- `student` -- the user object from the LoEvent
- `sentiment` -- the user's mood icon
- `primaryLine` / `secondaryLine` -- conditional display based on `showCourseTitle`
- `styles` -- theme-dependent card styles (heading, dimensions, image, icon sizes)
- `cardShellClass` -- assembled Tailwind class string with theme colors

The card layout: top strip has sentiment icon (left), student name as GitHub link (center), and LO type icon (right). Middle area has student avatar (left 26%), LO title/course (center), and LO image or icon (right 26%).

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\Students.svelte`**
Iterates `liveService.studentsOnline.value`, rendering each as a `StudentCard` in expanded/landscape layout. Used in the global live page's "Students" tab.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\Courses.svelte`**
Iterates `liveService.coursesOnline.value`, rendering each as a `Card` component (the generic learning-object Card).

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\CoursesGroup.svelte`**
Iterates `liveService.coursesOnline.value`, rendering each as a `CourseGroup` -- groups students by course.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\CourseGroup.svelte`**
For a single course: filters `liveService.studentsOnline.value` by `courseId` using `$derived`, then renders a `CourseGroupHeader` and one `StudentCard` per student. Filters out "Anon" users.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\ConnectLatestLosCards.svelte`**
Takes `los: LoRecord[]` and `emptyMessage: string`. Renders each as a `StudentCard` in expanded/landscape layout. Shows the empty message when the list is empty. Used in the per-course live page for both the "Online Now" and time-bucketed activity sections.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\CourseGroupHeader.svelte`**
Renders a header with two links: one to `/course/{courseId}` (with a course icon) and one to `/live/{courseId}` (with a live icon and "Live Stream" text).

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\time\Catalogue.svelte`**
Renders a list of `CourseVisit` records as generic `Card` components in compacted/landscape layout. Each card links to `/course/{id}` and displays a visit count metric.

### 3. Time Routes under `src/routes/(course-reader)/time/`

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(course-reader)\time\[courseid]\+page.ts`**
Loads the course, sets `currentCourse.value`, SSR disabled (`export const ssr = false`).

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(course-reader)\time\[courseid]\+page.svelte`**
Student calendar view. Uses a `$effect` to watch `currentCourse.value?.courseId` and `tutorsId.value?.login` and calls `TutorsTime.loadStudentTime()` when either changes. Renders `HeatMaps` and `Tables` components with `studentCalendar` data.

**Sub-components (all in the same directory):**
- **`HeatMaps.svelte`** -- Renders 4 heatmaps in a 2x2 grid: Calendar Activity, Lab Activity, Calendar Median, Lab Median. Uses `CalendarHeatmap`.
- **`CalendarHeatmap.svelte`** -- Wraps `jheat.js` library for calendar heatmap visualization. Color range goes 0-200 minutes in emerald green (`#50c878`). Uses `bind:this`, `onMount`, `onDestroy`. Browser-only rendering.
- **`Tables.svelte`** -- Container for 4 data tables: `StudentCalendarTable`, `CalendarByDayTable`, `StudentLabTable`, `LabByStepTable`.
- **`StudentCalendarTable.svelte`** -- Student's calendar by week, with rotated date headers, color-coded time cells via `cellColorForMinutes`, and a median comparison row.
- **`CalendarByDayTable.svelte`** -- Same structure as above but by individual day instead of week.
- **`StudentLabTable.svelte`** -- Lab-by-lab time grid with columns extracted via `extractLabIdentifier`.
- **`LabByStepTable.svelte`** -- Lab-by-step time grid with columns extracted via `extractStepName`.

All time tables share the same pattern: student row + optional median row, with `cellColorForMinutes()` for background coloring and `formatTimeMinutesOnly()` for display.

### 4. Layout Files and Service Initialization

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\+layout.server.ts`**
Server-side: retrieves auth session from `locals.auth()`, returns `{ loggedIn, user, locale }`.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\+layout.svelte`** (Root layout)
- Imports `../app.css`
- Calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect(data.user)` if user exists -- this reconnects to PartyKit, restores profile and sentiment from Supabase
- Calls `themeService.initDisplay()` in browser
- Uses `$effect` to set `document.documentElement.lang` reactively based on locale
- Renders just `{@render children()}`

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\routes\(course-reader)\+layout.svelte`**
- Wraps in `TutorsShell` (MainNavigator + Footer)
- Calls `tutorsConnectService.startTimer()` to begin 30-second analytics interval
- Uses `$effect` to track `page.params` changes and fire `learningEvent()`, `checkWhiteList()`, `courseVisit()`
- `afterNavigate` scrolls to content panel

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\TutorsShell.svelte`**
The main shell: sticky header with `MainNavigator`, scrollable `<main>` area, and a conditionally-shown `Footer`. Uses `hideMainNavigator` rune. Animations use `fly`/`slide` transitions with reduced-motion awareness.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\ui\navigators\MainNavigator.svelte`**
The top navbar. Conditionally renders based on `currentCourse` and `tutorsId`:
- Lead: `InfoButton` or `TutorsTitle` (when no course)
- Headline: `CourseTitle`
- Trail: `CalendarButton`, `CourseSentimentButton`, `LlmsIndicator`, `TutorsTimeIndicator`, `SearchButton`, `LayoutMenu`, separator, `AnonProfile` or `ConnectedProfile`, `TocButton`

### 5. Svelte 5 Runes Usage in Services

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts`** -- The central rune factory:
```typescript
export const rune = <T>(initialValue: T) => {
  let _rune = $state(initialValue);
  return {
    get value() { return _rune; },
    set value(v: T) { _rune = v; }
  };
};
```
This wraps `$state` in a `.value` getter/setter pattern. Exported runes: `currentLabStepIndex`, `adobeLoaded`, `animationDelay`, `currentLo`, `currentCourse`, `tutorsId`, `courseProtocol`, `hideMainNavigator`.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\services\community\types.svelte.ts`** -- `LoRecord` class uses `$state` on every field:
```typescript
export class LoRecord {
  courseId: string = $state("");
  courseUrl: string = $state("");
  courseTitle: string = $state("");
  loRoute: string = $state("");
  title: string = $state("");
  img?: string = $state("");
  icon?: IconType = $state();
  isPrivate: boolean = $state(false);
  user?: LoUser = $state<LoUser | undefined>();
  type: string = $state("");
  constructor(data: any) { Object.assign(this, data); }
}
```
This makes every property on every LoRecord individually reactive. When `refreshLoRecord()` updates a field, any UI reading it re-renders automatically.

**How services use the rune pattern:**
- `presenceService.studentsOnline` = `rune<LoRecord[]>([])` -- Accessed as `.value` everywhere
- `liveService.coursesOnline` = `rune<LoRecord[]>([])`
- `liveService.studentsOnline` = `rune<LoRecord[]>([])`
- `liveService.listeningForCourse` = `rune<string>("")`
- `themeService.layout` = `rune<LayoutType>("expanded")`
- `themeService.cardStyle` = `rune<CardStyleType>("portrait")`
- `themeService.lightMode` = `rune<string>("light")`
- `themeService.currentTheme` = `rune<string>("tutors")`

**How components consume reactive state:**
- Direct access: `liveService.coursesOnline.value.length` in template text
- `$derived`: `const students = $derived(liveService.studentsOnline.value.filter(...))` in CourseGroup
- `$derived.by()`: Complex filtering in the per-course live page for time-bucketed activity
- `$effect`: In root layout for locale changes, in course-reader layout for navigation tracking, in time page for loading data when course/student changes
- `$state` in components: `let connectRows = $state<TutorsConnectLatestRow[]>([])`, `let studentCalendar = $state<TutorsTimeStudent | null>(null)`

### 6. Data Flow Summary

The real-time presence system works through **PartyKit WebSockets**:
1. Root layout calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect()` which calls `presenceService.connectToAllCourseAccess()` -- opens a WebSocket to `tutors-all-course-access` room
2. Course-reader layout calls `presenceService.startPresenceListener(courseId)` -- opens a course-specific WebSocket
3. When a user navigates, `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent()` calls `presenceService.sendLoEvent()` -- broadcasts to both the global and course rooms
4. Incoming WebSocket messages update the `LoRecord` objects in-place via `refreshLoRecord()`, which triggers Svelte reactivity because `LoRecord` fields are `$state`
5. The live pages (`/live` and `/live/[courseid]`) read from `liveService` and `presenceService` respectively
6. The per-course live page also loads historical data from Supabase's `tutors-connect-latest` table

The historical data pipeline:
1. `presenceService.sendLoEvent()` also calls `upsertTutorsConnectLatestLo()` -- fire-and-forget write to Supabase
2. `/live/[courseid]` calls `getTutorsConnectLatestLosByCourseId()` on mount to fetch all stored snapshots
3. Results are time-bucketed using local date comparison functions (`isReceivedAtOnLocalDay`, etc.)

### 5. Svelte 5 Runes Usage in Services

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts`** -- The central rune factory:
```typescript
export const rune = <T>(initialValue: T) => {
  let _rune = $state(initialValue);
  return {
    get value() { return _rune; },
    set value(v: T) { _rune = v; }
  };
};
```
This wraps `$state` in a `.value` getter/setter pattern. Exported runes: `currentLabStepIndex`, `adobeLoaded`, `animationDelay`, `currentLo`, `currentCourse`, `tutorsId`, `courseProtocol`, `hideMainNavigator`.

**`D:\code\tutors_repo\src\lib\services\community\types.svelte.ts`** -- `LoRecord` class uses `$state` on every field:
```typescript
export class LoRecord {
  courseId: string = $state("");
  courseUrl: string = $state("");
  courseTitle: string = $state("");
  loRoute: string = $state("");
  title: string = $state("");
  img?: string = $state("");
  icon?: IconType = $state();
  isPrivate: boolean = $state(false);
  user?: LoUser = $state<LoUser | undefined>();
  type: string = $state("");
  constructor(data: any) { Object.assign(this, data); }
}
```
This makes every property on every LoRecord individually reactive. When `refreshLoRecord()` updates a field, any UI reading it re-renders automatically.

**How services use the rune pattern:**
- `presenceService.studentsOnline` = `rune<LoRecord[]>([])` -- Accessed as `.value` everywhere
- `liveService.coursesOnline` = `rune<LoRecord[]>([])`
- `liveService.studentsOnline` = `rune<LoRecord[]>([])`
- `liveService.listeningForCourse` = `rune<string>("")`
- `themeService.layout` = `rune<LayoutType>("expanded")`
- `themeService.cardStyle` = `rune<CardStyleType>("portrait")`
- `themeService.lightMode` = `rune<string>("light")`
- `themeService.currentTheme` = `rune<string>("tutors")`

**How components consume reactive state:**
- Direct access: `liveService.coursesOnline.value.length` in template text
- `$derived`: `const students = $derived(liveService.studentsOnline.value.filter(...))` in CourseGroup
- `$derived.by()`: Complex filtering in the per-course live page for time-bucketed activity
- `$effect`: In root layout for locale changes, in course-reader layout for navigation tracking, in time page for loading data when course/student changes
- `$state` in components: `let connectRows = $state<TutorsConnectLatestRow[]>([])`, `let studentCalendar = $state<TutorsTimeStudent | null>(null)`

### 6. Data Flow Summary

The real-time presence system works through **PartyKit WebSockets**:
1. Root layout calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect()` which calls `presenceService.connectToAllCourseAccess()` -- opens a WebSocket to `tutors-all-course-access` room
2. Course-reader layout calls `presenceService.startPresenceListener(courseId)` -- opens a course-specific WebSocket
3. When a user navigates, `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent()` calls `presenceService.sendLoEvent()` -- broadcasts to both the global and course rooms
4. Incoming WebSocket messages update the `LoRecord` objects in-place via `refreshLoRecord()`, which triggers Svelte reactivity because `LoRecord` fields are `$state`
5. The live pages (`/live` and `/live/[courseid]`) read from `liveService` and `presenceService` respectively
6. The per-course live page also loads historical data from Supabase's `tutors-connect-latest` table

The historical data pipeline:
1. `presenceService.sendLoEvent()` also calls `upsertTutorsConnectLatestLo()` -- fire-and-forget write to Supabase
2. `/live/[courseid]` calls `getTutorsConnectLatestLosByCourseId()` on mount to fetch all stored snapshots
3. Results are time-bucketed using local date comparison functions (`isReceivedAtOnLocalDay`, etc.)
